description: This file contains acceptance test cases for the AOS_PDF_Templates module in a SuiteCRM project. It defines a test class that automates UI testing scenarios like viewing and creating PDF templates using the Codeception testing framework.

classes.name: AOS_PDF_TemplatesCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for AOS_PDF_Templates module, implementing test scenarios for viewing and creating PDF templates.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method to initialize Faker data generator and seed it with a random seed before each test.

methods.name: testScenarioViewPDFTemplatesModule
methods.description: Test scenario to verify that the PDF Templates module page can be accessed and displays the correct title.

methods.name: testScenarioCreatePDFTemplate
methods.description: Test scenario to verify creation and deletion of a PDF template, including navigating to the list view, creating a template with fake data, and deleting it.
